title.zh: 将Ormoc市Ormoc区医院床位由125张增至150张并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Increasing the Bed Capacity of the Ormoc District Hospital in Ormoc City, From One Hundred Twenty-five (125) to One Hundred Fifty (150) Beds, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Increasing the Bed Capacity of the Ormoc District Hospital in Ormoc City, From One Hundred Twenty-five (125) to One Hundred Fifty (150) Beds, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tăng sức chứa giường bệnh của Bệnh viện Huyện Ormoc tại Thành phố Ormoc từ 125 lên 150 giường, và phân bổ kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเพิ่มจำนวนเตียงของโรงพยาบาลอำเภอ Ormoc ในเมือง Ormoc จาก 125 เป็น 150 เตียง และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang meningkatkan kapasitas tempat tidur Rumah Sakit Distrik Ormoc di Kota Ormoc dari 125 menjadi 150 tempat tidur, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta meningkatkan kapasiti katil Hospital Daerah Ormoc di Bandar Ormoc daripada 125 kepada 150 katil, serta memperuntukkan dana

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1992/ra_7262_1992.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The bed capacity of the Ormoc District Hospital in Ormoc City is hereby increased from one hundred twenty-five (125) to one hundred fifty (150) beds.

The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be charged against the lump-sum appropriations authorized for the purpose under the current General Appropriations Act. Thereafter, such sums as may be necessary for the operation and maintenance of the hospital shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
